purpose: Quantify uncertainty of the already specified same P-down month relative quote changes; not a new selection or return experiment. GP signal consistent across two eras and omitted-year diagnostics, unlike weak mean return; not yet evidence of adoptable risk protection.
primary: B-M conditional on same scope/scenario P<0; B-D required simpler dilution rival; others complete context, no metric winner
statistic: mean of original dated lhs-rhs in original same scope/scenario P<0 months; each resample draws all 132 dated positions and selects by original P<0 label with multiplicity; never resample only down months independently

resampling.shared_indices: exact original evaluator generator and index serialization/hash; all scopes/scenarios/contrasts use same draw for each length
resampling.no_down_draw: exclude that draw and report valid count; do not fill zero

stability: reuse original two eras/every year/leave-one-year results, no new partition
test_requirements: conditional denominator counts sampled down observations only
circular wrap and shared indices identity against original recorded hash
all-up draw yields missing not zero
constant paired difference has degenerate interval
limitations: post-core exploratory followup; not independent confirmation
intervals do not resolve source selection bias or industry snapshot uncertainty
97.5 interval is not simultaneous guarantee for all comparisons and risk metrics
does not show independence from volatility/liquidity/value or implementable wealth
no P-down state prediction or live timing rule tested
drawdown/worst-tail descriptive results do not become risk-control proofs
execution_requires: root reviewed code hashes and final run contract
